strings.text: Warm light, brick and the silence between the notes.
strings.translation: Luz cálida, ladrillo y el silencio entre las notas.

strings.text: The city outside the window is lighting its windows.
strings.translation: La ciudad, al otro lado de la ventana, enciende sus ventanas.

strings.text: The lid is open: someone has just been playing.
strings.translation: La tapa está abierta: alguien acaba de tocar.

strings.text: The cat has taken the bench and has no plans to give it up.
strings.translation: El gato se ha quedado con la banqueta y no piensa cederla.

strings.text: One click on the bulbs, and the light goes out.
strings.translation: Un clic en las bombillas, y la luz se apaga.
